description: This file defines a Java entity class 'Notification' representing notifications stored in a database, including fields for id, userId, type, message, readAt, and createdAt, with appropriate JPA annotations for persistence.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Entity class representing a notification, with fields for id, userId, type, message, readAt, createdAt, and methods to access and manipulate these fields.

methods.name: Notification()
methods.description: Protected default constructor required by JPA.

methods.name: Notification(Long userId, String type, String message)
methods.description: Constructor to create a new Notification with specified userId, type, and message.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the notification.

methods.name: getUserId()
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the notification.

methods.name: getType()
methods.description: Returns the type/category of the notification.

methods.name: getMessage()
methods.description: Returns the message content of the notification.

methods.name: getReadAt()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the notification was read, if any.

methods.name: getCreatedAt()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the notification was created.

methods.name: markRead()
methods.description: Marks the notification as read by setting the readAt timestamp to the current time.
